question: Can a held-parity router read native entry-12 state and selectively choose the A1 coordinate, A2 coordinate, or off branch of the causally sufficient construction union?

prior_art.known_lessons: Both fixed oracle experts collide on parity-0 P, so expert choice alone is insufficient; the two-coordinate union is sufficient; linear P complementation destroys target; held labels or output margins may not gate the intervention.
prior_art.novelty: Fit a three-way A1/A2/off nearest-centroid router solely on native upstream-off entry12 state from opposite parity, then causally execute the corresponding fixed expert delta projected into the shared construction union.

frozen_design.router_features: Native upstream-off entry12 residual vector at each row's semantic position, L2-normalized after subtracting the training global mean.
frozen_design.router: Three deterministic cosine nearest centroids for A1, A2, and off=(P union C), fit on opposite parity only; ties resolve A1 then A2 then off. No regularization or threshold selection.
frozen_design.causal_program: For each held row predicted A1/A2, take that fixed oracle expert's entry12 on-minus-off tensor, project it into the opposite-parity two-construction DIM union, and install off plus the projected semantic prefix. Rows predicted off receive zero delta.
frozen_design.controls: Report the router confusion matrix, ungated construction-union expert arms, gold-label router upper bound, zero state, full expert states, A1/A2/P/C margin effects, and P/C KL/flips. Gold labels cannot select or modify the learned router.
frozen_design.evaluation: Both held parities, with no refit or outcome selection. A1 and A2 are target panels; P/C are off panels.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_scope_geometry_f: Hashes, state/basis authorities, parent/full/zero replays, opposite-parity scope, finite geometry, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_router_identifies_held_branches: Held macro accuracy across A1/A2/off is >=.875 in both parities, with no P/C row predicted A1 or A2.
predictions.pred_c_routed_union_preserves_both_targe: The routed program projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 on both A1 and A2 in both held parities.
predictions.pred_d_routed_union_is_control_selective: The routed program has zero P/C top-one flips and changed-versus-off mean KL <=.02 in both held parities.
predictions.pred_e_router_retains_ungated_union_effe: Routed A1/A2 signed projection is at least 90% of the corresponding ungated expert construction-union projection in every held cell.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E licenses the finite routed state program for OOD router testing and weight translation of both coordinate and router interfaces. B failure rejects this native-state linear router. B without C rejects the mixture execution or union composability. C without D means the learned gate still leaks into controls. A gold-router pass with learned-router failure localizes the obstacle to branch identification rather than the causal coordinates.
